Hi Carmen — thanks for the COI, received. A couple of next steps from procurement so we can move toward a PO: 

1) Endorsement: We do require Additional Insured endorsement on General Liability for third-party vendors that handle non-sensitive production telemetry. The COI you sent looks close but I need Procurement to confirm the endorsement language.

2) Please complete the Vendor Risk Screener attached — it just captures subcontractor use, data flows, and cyber coverage limits. We typically need that for vendors integrating with our APIs.

3) PO timing: conditional PO can be issued once we have (a) signed SOW or contract template, (b) completed vendor screener, and (c) confirmation that endorsement will be added or an acceptable mitigation is in place. Standard turnaround is 3-5 business days after those items.

I've attached a blank screener for quick completion. Once Marissa confirms endorsement wording we'll confirm if the COI as-is is acceptable for the conditional PO.

Attachment: vendor-risk-screener.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Next actions: Carmen — please populate the screener and confirm whether your carrier will issue the additional insured endorsement; Marissa/Jonas — can you confirm the minimum endorsement text we accept in prod integrations?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer

On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 2:45 PM karthik.iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> I've attached a blank screener for quick completion. Once Marissa confirms endorsement wording we'll confirm if the COI as-is is acceptable for the conditional PO.

Thanks — quick guidance from Procurement: for Additional Insured we ask for the CG 20 10 or equivalent wording referencing Commercial General Liability and endorsement that applies to ongoing operations (not just completed ops). If the carrier can add:

  Redwood Inference, Inc.
  415 Santa Clara Ave
  San Francisco, CA 94107

as Additional Insured with waiver of subrogation on the GL policy, that will cover us for the conditional PO. If the insurer cannot provide CG 20 10 specifically, a carrier statement that grants additional insured status for ongoing operations is acceptable — please attach the endorsement PDF.

Also Jonas — from Security side, if Dataspry indicates any subcontractors or persistent log access in the screener, we’ll need either cyber E&O coverage limits >= $2M or a compensating controls plan.

Marissa Cole
